new.title: New Session
new.detectAgentFirst: Detect or add an Agent in Settings first.
new.worktreeHint: Need a new branch? Create a Worktree from the context menu first.
new.titlePlaceholder: Leave blank to generate a name such as {{example}}
new.piNotice: Pi starts in its native TUI, preserving its terminal interactions, extensions, and theme. Pi has no built-in per-action approval and runs with your local user permissions.
new.qoderNotice: Qoder keeps its native approvals unless you explicitly select a broader permission mode.
new.argumentsHint: Arguments are appended to the command as an argv array and are never joined through a shell.
new.shellPermissionNote: Generic Shell does not use Agent permission modes; it starts directly as a terminal Session.
new.piPermissionNote: Pi does not offer auto/bypass modes. Secrets are injected only from configured Secret references or environment variables.
new.qoderParameterNote: AgentPort manages Qoder Session, Worktree, remote, settings, and selected permission arguments; they cannot be overridden here.
new.autoWarning: Auto approve allows file writes and Shell commands without individual confirmation.
new.bypassWarning: All permission checks are bypassed. This is dangerous.
new.nativeHint: Use each CLI's native approvals without adding any bypass arguments.
